new_scholarship.name: Borsa di studio DSU Toscana — University of Pisa students
new_scholarship.funding_type: Regional need-based scholarship: cash quota, free canteen meals, accommodation and regional tax exemption (no stipend published for a set amount)
new_scholarship.program_type: Regional right-to-study need-based scholarship (concorso) awarded by the regional agency, applied for separately from university admission
new_scholarship.official_source: Azienda Regionale Diritto allo Studio Universitario (ARDSU) — DSU Toscana, Regione Toscana
new_scholarship.duration: Annual benefit. Winners of the annual scholarship hold the canteen and accommodation benefits from 01.10.2026 to 30.09.2027; winners of the semestre filtro scholarship from 01.10.2026 to 31.03.2027; doctoral and specialisation-course winners from 01.01.2027 to 31.12.2027. The scholarship is open to students enrolled for the achievement of their FIRST degree, so it is recompeted each academic year rather than granted for a fixed multi-year term.
new_scholarship.deadline: 13.00 (Italian time) on 7 September 2026 for the a.a. 2026/2027 call, covering laurea triennale, laurea magistrale and laurea magistrale a ciclo unico; the window opened at 12.00 on 20 July 2026. For students enrolled on doctoral and specialisation courses the window ran from 25 September 2026 to 13.00 on 16 November 2026.
new_scholarship.application_period: Annual competitive call for academic year 2026/2027: applications open at 12.00 on 20 July 2026 and close at 13.00 on 7 September 2026 for first-cycle (laurea triennale) and second-cycle (laurea magistrale, laurea magistrale a ciclo unico) students. A later window runs from 25 September 2026 to 13.00 on 16 November 2026 for students enrolled on doctoral and specialisation courses. The previous a.a. 2025-26 call closed on 6 September 2025.
new_scholarship.application_method: Separate application, not automatic on admission. Candidates complete the domanda di borsa di studio through the DSU Toscana Sportello Studente portal at https://sportellostudente.dsu.toscana.it. The University of Pisa does not award this scholarship and does not process it: its own page tells students to request the borsa di studio from the DSU and links to dsu.toscana.it.
new_scholarship.description: Il Diritto allo Studio Universitario in Toscana is administered by the Azienda Regionale Diritto allo Studio Universitario (ARDSU, 'DSU Toscana'), a regional agency, whose scholarship (borsa di studio) is the principal need-based funding instrument for students at the University of Pisa. The University of Pisa does not award it: its scholarships page states that students can request a borsa di studio from the DSU and links to the DSU call. The scholarship gives winners a monetary quota that varies with the family's economic condition and with whether the student is in sede, pendolare or fuori sede, plus free access to DSU canteen services, free accommodation for winners subject to availability (EUR 262.50 per month for eligible non-winners) and exemption from the regional right-to-study tax. The a.a. 2026/2027 call is promoted within Giovanisì, the Regione Toscana project for youth autonomy, and co-financed by the regional Toscana FSE+ 2021-2027 programme. The application closes at 13.00 on 7 September 2026 for laurea triennale, laurea magistrale and laurea magistrale a ciclo unico students, so the cycle for the verification date is closed.
new_scholarship.best_fit: Students who are, or intend to be, enrolled on their first degree at the University of Pisa and whose families meet the ISEE and ISPE economic thresholds of the call, particularly fuori sede students who need an accommodation place and free canteen meals, and students in a first laurea triennale or laurea magistrale a ciclo unico year. Not suitable for anyone already holding an equivalent-level title, not suitable for students who have enrolled on a master's degree after already graduating at that level, and not a tuition-fee scholarship: the published amounts for the a.a. 2026/2027 cycle run from EUR 1,060 to EUR 3,880 and cover the monetary quota together with free services, while tuition is only affected indirectly through any separate ISEE-based fee exemption.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: The concorso is open to students regularly enrolled for the achievement of their FIRST degree on laurea, laurea specialistica/magistrale, dottorato di ricerca and scuole di specializzazione courses at the universities of Florence, Pisa and Siena and at the other higher institutes, art academies and conservatories of the Tuscany region. The University of Pisa states the same rule from its own side: all students who wish to enrol or are already enrolled on a laurea course at the University of Pisa and who apply, provided they do not already hold an academic title of the same level. Economic requirements are expressed through the ISEE and ISPE indicators of the DSU, and the call also sets merit requirements (art. 5.3 of the call, verified by the Agency through official acquisition of valid credits for the enrolled course). Students with a recognised disability under art. 3 of Law 104/1992 or with invalidity of 66% or more, students with minor children and nationally competitive athletes have dedicated merit requirements and higher income limits; first-year students with a disability are exempt from the merit-based decadenza that applies to other students.

Total scholarship value of EUR 1,060 to EUR 3,880 per academic year by ISEE band and student category (Art. 19.1.1 Table B1), comprising the monetary quota and the value of the free services
Free university canteen service: one free meal per day for resident and commuter students, two free meals a day plus accommodation for non-resident students

Free place in a DSU Toscana residence for winners subject to availability; EUR 262.50 per month for eligible non-winners, who may keep the place for the second semester by applying online between 1 and 15 March 2027

Rent subsidy in lieu of accommodation of EUR 3,150.00 per year (EUR 1,575.00 six-month), applied for between 4 November and 15 December 2026, plus an extraordinary one-off supplement of up to EUR 100 per month for the months of rent assistance

new_scholarship.selection_notes: Selection is by economic condition and merit, not by nationality or academic competition alone. The Agency assigns the benefit after a need analysis built on the ISEE and ISPE indicators of the DSU, with thresholds published in the call of ISEE EUR 27,000.00 and ISPE EUR 60,000.00, and applies merit requirements that the Agency verifies through official acquisition (acquisizione d'ufficio) of the valid credits registered for the course the student is enrolled on. For a first-year laurea triennale student, art. 5.3 requires 20 credits by 10 August 2027 to receive the second 50% instalment, with a second chance by 30 November 2027 to retain the 50% already received, and bonus credits cannot be used for the threshold; merit for later years is 25 credits for the second standard year, 80 for the third and 135 for the fourth, and for students from foreign universities the requirement is assessed on the credits recognised by the university of new enrolment. No interview is published. The outcome produces a ranking of vincitori (winners) and idonei non vincitori (eligible non-winners): both categories get free canteen access and exemption from the regional fee; the accommodation place is free for winners and charged at EUR 262.50 per month to eligible non-winners, and the cash quota is paid to winners. Results for laurea triennale and laurea magistrale a ciclo unico first years were published as provisional on 30 September 2026 and definitive on 4 November 2026 for the scholarship alone, with a further definitive date of 30 November 2026.

new_scholarship.notes:
PROVENANCE OF THE AWARD, stated plainly because the assigned award name is misleading. The b03
assignment names 'Borse di Studio - Universita di Pisa' on host unipi.it, but the University of
Pisa does not award this scholarship and does not run it. The University's own page 'Borse di
studio e Posti Alloggio DSU Toscana' (https://www.unipi.it/campus-e-servizi/servizi/borse-di-studio-e-posti-alloggio-dsu-toscana/)
opens with 'Gli studenti possono richiedere una borsa di studio del DSU, Azienda Regionale Diritto
allo Studio Universitario' and links to https://www.dsu.toscana.it/borsa-di-studio, and the
University's other scholarships page states that 'Il Diritto allo Studio Universitario in Toscana e
gestito dal DSU Toscana'. The awarding body is therefore ARDSU (Azienda Regionale Diritto allo
Studio Universitario), a regional agency, and the record is written against that body. No
substitution of a different award was made; the assigned target resolves to this published
scheme under its real name.

LOGO PROVENANCE, corrected in the finishing pass. An earlier version of this record carried the
University of Pisa mark (https://www.unipi.it/wp-content/uploads/Raggruppa-3020.svg). That was a
provenance error under the contract's rule that a logo must belong to the body awarding the
scholarship: the University of Pisa is the eligible institution, not the awarding body. The record
now carries the DSU Toscana mark served from the awarding body's own domain,
https://www.dsu.toscana.it/image/layout_set_logo?img_id=21919169 (HTTP 200, image/png, 8,267
bytes, 407x104, 51.5% of opaque pixels dark, so it is not a white-on-transparent wordmark). The
unipi.it mark was re-probed and is still valid, but it is deliberately not used.

AMOUNTS, recovered in a finishing pass from the awarding body's own English call for application (https://www.dsu.toscana.it/documents/4390857/32478257/EN_bando+borsa+alloggio+2026-2027.pdf/, 72 pages, vers. 1.0 del 07/08/2026), after an earlier pass had left funding_amount null. The ISEE and ISPE thresholds are ISEE EUR 27,000.00 and ISPE EUR 60,000.00 (ISEE EUR 34,600.00 and ISPE EUR 70,000.00 for students with disabilities), and Art. 19.1.1 Table B1 publishes the total scholarship value by band and student category, from EUR 1,060 to EUR 3,880. The monetary portion alone is not separately stated in the PDF, only the Table B1 totals and the Table B5 values of the free services. The English text states that it is provided solely to facilitate reading and that the Italian text prevails, so the Italian PDF is the binding source for the amounts.

programme_detail_official.deadline_note: The DSU Toscana call page states the application window as opening at 12.00 on 20 July 2026 and closing at 13.00 on 7 September 2026 for students enrolled, or intending to enrol, on laurea triennale, laurea magistrale and laurea magistrale a ciclo unico courses. A separate window opens on 25 September 2026 and closes at 13.00 on 16 November 2026 for students enrolled on doctoral and specialisation courses. The deadline for holding the DSU is the same 7 September 2026 date. No timezone is printed; Italy observes CEST on 7 September 2026, so the deadline is read as Europe/Rome local time. As at the verification date of 2026-10-03 the 13.00 7 September 2026 deadline is in the past, which is why the status is CLOSED and the next cycle is expected in the first half of July 2027 (the equivalent a.a. 2025-26 call closed on 6 September 2025).
programme_detail_official.status_note: The a.a. 2026/2027 concorso closed at 13.00 Italian time on 7 September 2026 for first-cycle and second-cycle degree students, which is in the past as at the verification date of 2026-10-03. The Agency is still running the 2026/2027 contest through its instalment and results schedule, so the award itself remains live for admitted winners rather than closed: canteen and accommodation benefits run to 30 September 2027, the first instalments were due on 10 November and 31 December 2026, and the definitive rankings for scholarship holders were due on 4 and 30 November 2026. The next full cycle is expected to open in the second half of July 2027 for academic year 2027/2028; the previous call (a.a. 2025-26) closed on 6 September 2025, and the Agency publishes each year's call on the same page.

For the 2026/2027 contest, free canteen access and accommodation run from 01.10.2026 to 30.09.2027 for winners of the annual scholarship, from 01.10.2026 to 31.03.2027 for winners of the semestre filtro scholarship, and from 01.01.2027 to 31.12.2027 for doctoral and specialisation-course winners.
programme_detail_official.tuition_coverage_note: No tuition waiver is confirmed. The DSU Toscana page scopes the fee reduction narrowly: winners and eligible non-winners 'spetta, inoltre, l'esonero dalla tassa regionale per il diritto allo studio universitario' — that is, exemption from the regional right-to-study fee, not from the University of Pisa tuition or registration fees. The University of Pisa page phrases the same benefit more broadly as 'esonero dalle tasse universitarie'. Because the awarding agency's own wording is the narrower one, and the awarding body's own English 'Call for application' PDF (Bando di concorso a.a. 2026/2027, read in full) grants no tuition waiver — its Art. 19.2.1 exempting only 'the regional tax due for registration and enrolment, the amount of which is set at 140.00' — this record does not claim that university tuition is waived, and the wider University of Pisa phrasing is flagged as unconfirmed in institution_check_required. Any tuition reduction a student obtains is a separate consequence of the ISEE-based exemption rules published by the University, not of this scholarship.

Tuition, travel and living costs beyond the quota are not covered, so the award is not a fully funded package.

programme_detail_official.citizenship_residency: No nationality restriction. Eligibility is set by economic condition (ISEE and ISPE), by enrolment for a first degree at a Tuscan institution, and by the merit requirements of the call. The call is published in Italian, English, French, Arabic and Chinese, which is the Agency's own signal that it is addressed to students outside the Italian-speaking population, and the Agency maintains a dedicated 'Studenti Stranieri' page whose content was not read for this record. The residence distinction that matters for benefits is not nationality but commuting status — in sede, pendolare or fuori sede — determined by provenance and public-transport travel time to the course location.
programme_detail_official.international_eligibility: Open to students of any nationality, including students without Italian citizenship, subject to the same ISEE/ISPE and merit requirements. The call itself is issued in five languages including English, Arabic and Chinese. Non-EU nationals face one practical constraint that is economic rather than legal: the DSU used to determine the ISEE and ISPE indicators is the Italian DSU, so a student from abroad must be able to obtain one valid for facilitated right-to-study services by 7 September 2026, which is something to confirm with the Agency's dedicated foreign-student page (https://www.dsu.toscana.it/studenti-stranieri) before relying on this scholarship. No separate international quota is published on the page.
programme_detail_official.study_mode: Not specified on the pages read. The DSU page states the concorso is open to students 'regolarmente iscritti per il conseguimento del primo titolo di studio' on laurea, laurea specialistica/magistrale, dottorato di ricerca and scuole di specializzazione courses, and does not distinguish full-time from part-time enrolment, so no study-mode condition is recorded.
programme_detail_official.subject_or_agency_requirement: No subject restriction. The concorso is open across the courses of the universities of Florence, Pisa and Siena and the other Tuscan higher institutes, art academies and conservatories, so all fields at the University of Pisa are covered. Two specific provisions are subject-linked in effect rather than by field: the 'Semestre filtro' scholarship applies to Medicine, Veterinary Medicine and Dentistry students, and the Agency notes that regional filtering rules affect students enrolled on those courses in other regions. Course fees and other charges vary by course and are not covered by the scholarship.
programme_detail_official.application_method: Separate, competitive application. The candidate completes the domanda di borsa di studio through the DSU Toscana Sportello Studente portal at https://sportellostudente.dsu.toscana.it, and must hold a DSU valid for facilitated right-to-study services subscribed by 7 September 2026. There is no automatic consideration on admission to the University of Pisa.
programme_detail_official.application_route: Submit the online domanda di borsa di study and domanda di posto alloggio through the DSU Toscana Sportello Studente portal (https://sportellostudente.dsu.toscana.it, 'Domanda / Application 2026/2027'), having first subscribed to a DSU. The call documents, including the English 'Call for application', are downloadable from the 'Bando di concorso 2026/2027' section of the DSU page. The University of Pisa's role is only to identify and link to this route from its own scholarships pages.

award_holder_conditions: The beneficiary must be enrolled for the achievement of the FIRST degree, so holding an equivalent-level title forfeits the benefit
The monetary quota is paid in instalments, and the second instalment is conditional on reaching the merit requirement of art. 5.3 of the call

Payments are made by bank transfer to a current account or prepaid card with an Italian or SEPA-area IBAN in the beneficiary student's own name; if the student does not yet hold an IBAN it must be communicated through the online form by the mandatory deadline of 31 December 2028

In the event of decadenza or reduction of a benefit the Agency notifies the outcome by ticket through the Sportello Studente, giving a mandatory 10-day window for rebuttals or clarifications, followed by formal notice by raccomandata setting out the measure, any amount to be repaid, the sanction and the payment method

Repayment of sums and payment of any sanction may be made in a single solution or in instalments of up to 24 monthly instalments with a minimum of EUR 60 per instalment, under art. 13 of the Regolamento accertamenti; missing two consecutive instalments forfeits the instalment arrangement and the whole residual balance becomes payable immediately
No service bond, work obligation or return-to-Tuscany obligation is published; the obligations published are academic merit and repayment on forfeiture, not service
supplements_or_initiatives: DSU Toscana 'Posto alloggio': the companion accommodation service governed by the same call, free for scholarship winners and EUR 262.50 per month for eligible non-winners, subject to availability.

DSU Toscana 'Contributo affitto': a separate rent contribution listed among the Agency's services that can, in the cases provided for by the call, be elected by students with a disability as an alternative to a residence place.
DSU Toscana 'Mobilità internazionale': a separate international mobility contribution listed among the Agency's services, outside this record.
DSU Toscana 'Monetizzazione dei servizi' and 'Mantenimento dei servizi': further mechanisms for converting or retaining services, listed by the Agency and not read for this record.

University of Pisa 'Collaborazioni part-time (150 ore)': part-time collaborations for students in services for the student community (library, laboratory, administration, archive), governed by the Regolamento for part-time student collaborations at https://www.unipi.it/wp-content/uploads/partime.pdf. This is a work opportunity, not a scholarship, and is described on the University's scholarships-and-support page alongside the DSU route.
University of Pisa 'Premi e borse di studio': a separate University page listing prizes and scholarships, not read for this record.

Invest Your Talent in Italy: a programme listed under the University's international relations programmes and reachable from its international-registration section, whose content was not read for this record.

programme_detail_official.description: The borsa di studio is awarded by the Azienda Regionale Diritto allo Studio Universitario (DSU Toscana), the regional agency that manages the right to university study in Tuscany under articles 3 and 34 of the Italian Constitution, and is the principal need-based funding instrument for students enrolled at the University of Pisa. The University of Pisa does not award it: its own pages tell students to request the scholarship from the DSU and link to the DSU call. Winners receive a total scholarship value published by band and student category in Art. 19.1.1 Table B1 of the call, ranging from EUR 1,060 for a non-resident student in the highest ISEE band to EUR 3,880 for a commuter student in the lowest ISEE band and comprising both the monetary quota and the value of the free services, plus free access to DSU canteen services, a free residence place subject to availability (EUR 262.50 per month for eligible non-winners) and exemption from the EUR 140.00 regional right-to-study fee. Economic eligibility is assessed through the ISEE and ISPE indicators of the DSU, which must not exceed ISEE EUR 27,000.00 and ISPE EUR 60,000.00, and merit requirements of art. 5.3 are verified by the Agency through official acquisition of valid credits: a first-year laurea triennale student must acquire 20 credits by 10 August 2027. Applications are made through the DSU Sportello Studente portal; the a.a. 2026/2027 window closed at 13.00 on 7 September 2026 for first- and second-cycle students.
programme_detail_official.program_type: Regional right-to-study need-based scholarship awarded by a regional agency and applied for separately from university admission
programme_detail_official.coverage: Need-based support published as a total value of EUR 1,060 to EUR 3,880 per academic year (Art. 19.1.1 Table B1, comprising the monetary quota plus the value of the free services), with free canteen meals, a free DSU residence place for winners subject to availability (EUR 262.50 per month for eligible non-winners), a rent subsidy of EUR 3,150.00 where residence places are insufficient, and exemption from the EUR 140.00 regional right-to-study fee. Not covered: University of Pisa tuition and registration fees, travel, and living costs beyond the quota. The scholarship is therefore need-based support rather than a fully funded package, and tuition is only affected indirectly through any separate ISEE-based fee exemption the student holds.

application_readiness_checklist: Understand who awards this before you plan around it: the University of Pisa does not award the borsa di studio. The awarding body is ARDSU / DSU Toscana, and the University's pages only point you to the DSU call.

Confirm you are applying for your FIRST degree. The University states that a student enrolling on a laurea magistrale cannot receive the scholarship if they already hold a laurea magistrale, and the DSU states the same first-degree rule.

Start the DSU early. The call requires a DSU valid for facilitated right-to-study services, relating to you as the applicant student, subscribed by 7 September 2026 — a deadline in its own right, not a formality.

Watch the window, not just the closing date: the a.a. 2026/2027 window opened at 12.00 on 20 July 2026 and closed at 13.00 on 7 September 2026. The Agency's own page gives the opening time, so prepare before the window opens.
If you are on a doctoral or specialisation course, use the later window: 25 September 2026 to 13.00 on 16 November 2026.
Submit through the DSU Sportello Studente portal (https://sportellostudente.dsu.toscana.it), not through the University of Pisa.
Have an Italian or SEPA-area IBAN for an account or prepaid card in your own name ready, because the quota is paid by transfer and the IBAN is declared in the application.

Read the English 'Call for application' PDF in the Bando di concorso 2026/2027 section rather than relying on the summary page, since the summary does not publish the ISEE/ISPE thresholds or the art. 5.3 merit requirements.

If you are a fuori sede student, submit the domanda di posto alloggio as well: residence places are allocated within the same call and subject to availability, and winners get them free while eligible non-winners pay EUR 262.50 per month.

Budget for what the scholarship does not cover: University of Pisa tuition and registration fees, travel, and anything beyond the cash quota and canteen. Treat the cash quota amount as unknown until you see the published figure for your commuting status.
Plan the renewal from year one: the benefit is for students on their first degree and is recomputed annually, and the second instalment depends on reaching the merit requirement of art. 5.3.
common_rejection_risks: Missing the 13.00 closing time on 7 September 2026 by treating it as an end-of-day deadline. The Agency states the hour explicitly.
Assuming the University of Pisa will consider you automatically. The borsa di studio is a separate concorso applied for at the DSU, and there is no automatic consideration on admission.
Applying while already holding an equivalent-level title, which forfeits the benefit.
Not holding a valid DSU by 7 September 2026, or holding a DSU that does not relate to you as the applicant student.

Applying in the wrong window: doctoral and specialisation students have a different closing date (16 November 2026), and laurea triennale, laurea magistrale and magistrale a ciclo unico students the 7 September 2026 one.

Reading 'esonero dalle tasse universitarie' on the University of Pisa page as a tuition waiver and then discovering the DSU scopes it to the regional right-to-study fee only. The two pages phrase the same benefit differently.
Assuming the accommodation place is guaranteed. The Agency grants it 'nei limiti delle disponibilità', and eligible non-winners pay EUR 262.50 per month.
Not declaring an Italian or SEPA IBAN, or declaring one not in your own name, so the quota cannot be paid.
Not meeting the merit requirement of art. 5.3 and so losing the second instalment of the quota.
Losing the benefit through decadenza or reduction and then repaying sums plus a sanction, with only a 10-day window for rebuttals after the Agency's ticket.
Missing two consecutive instalments of a repayment arrangement and forfeiting the rateisation, making the whole residual balance payable at once.

Budgeting from a stale figure. The quota amount varies with economic condition and commuting status, and the summary page publishes no amount at all, so a figure from another region or another year is not a substitute.
estimated_uncovered_costs: University of Pisa tuition and registration fees. The scholarship is not a tuition waiver: the DSU scopes its exemption to the tassa regionale, and the University's broader phrasing was not confirmed against the call. Budget the full fee unless you separately qualify for an ISEE-based exemption.

Living costs in Pisa beyond the cash quota. The quota is described as varying with economic condition and commuting status and the summary page publishes no amount, so no monthly or annual figure is recorded in this record; read the amount for your own in sede / pendolare / fuori sede category in the English call before budgeting.
Residence costs for eligible non-winners, who pay EUR 262.50 per month for the place that winners receive free.

Accommodation for students who do not get a DSU place, including the difference between a subsidised residence place and market rent in a university city. The Agency also offers a 'Cerco Alloggio' service and a separate 'Contributo affitto'.
Travel to and from Pisa, which the scholarship does not cover at all.
Study materials, laboratory and fieldwork costs, and the sport and book costs that the University page describes the cash quota as being intended to help with.
The regional right-to-study fee for students who are neither winners nor eligible non-winners, since the exemption applies only to those two categories.
Visa and residence-permit costs for non-EU nationals, and the cost of obtaining documentation for the DSU if you are applying from outside Italy.
Health cover and insurance, which the pages read do not connect to this scholarship.
Repayment exposure if the benefit is reduced or revoked: sums returned plus a sanction, under a 10-day rebuttal window and with rateisation capped at 24 instalments of at least EUR 60.
document_audit: The DSU page publishes an online application through the Sportello Studente portal and requires a DSU valid for facilitated right-to-study services, subscribed by 7 September 2026, relating to the applicant student. This is the only document the summary page names explicitly.

The IBAN requirement is stated on the DSU page: instalments are paid by bank transfer to a current account or prepaid card with an Italian or SEPA-area IBAN in the beneficiary student's own name, and the IBAN is declared in the application.

Merit is verified by the Agency 'tramite l'acquisizione d'ufficio dei crediti registrati validi' for the course the student is enrolled on in 2026/2027, so a transcript is not something the student submits for this purpose.

The call itself, and the register of requirements, are in the 'Bando di concorso 2026/2027' section, which offers the bando in Italian, English, French, Arabic and Chinese, plus FAQ. The English 'Call for application' PDF was read in full (72 pp.) and its Art. 8.3 sets out the documentation to be submitted by foreign students: EU students file the self-declaration in Appendix D on 2025 household gross income, buildings owned at 31/12/2025 and foreign movable assets, plus rent paid for the family's main residence; non-EU students file documentation issued by the competent authorities of the country where the income was generated and the assets are held, and all documents produced in the original language and legalised must be translated into Italian and legalised by Italian diplomatic authorities in the country of origin or under the international conventions on legalisation, with Art. 8.3.2.6 adding that 'No form of substitute declaration, self-certification, affidavit can be accepted'.
The University of Pisa page adds no document requirements of its own; it describes the benefit and the eligible population and links to the DSU.

The DSU 'Studenti Stranieri' page (https://www.dsu.toscana.it/studenti-stranieri) is the Agency's dedicated route for foreign students and was not read for this record; it is the right place to confirm any additional documentation required of applicants from outside Italy.

submission_workflow: Read the English 'Call for application' in the Bando di concorso 2026/2027 section of https://www.dsu.toscana.it/borsa-di-studio to get the ISEE/ISPE thresholds and the merit requirements the summary page does not publish.
Obtain a DSU valid for facilitated right-to-study services relating to you as the applicant student, before 7 September 2026.
Prepare an Italian or SEPA-area IBAN for an account or prepaid card in your own name.
Apply, or enrol, for the first degree on a laurea course of the University of Pisa.

When the window opens (12.00 on 20 July 2026 for the 2026/2027 cycle), submit the domanda di borsa di studio, and the domanda di posto alloggio if you need a place, through https://sportellostudente.dsu.toscana.it.
Submit before 13.00 on 7 September 2026 (13.00 on 16 November 2026 for doctoral and specialisation students).

Check the rankings: provisional on 30 September 2026, definitive on 4 November 2026 for the scholarship alone and 30 November 2026 for the full set, for laurea triennale and magistrale a ciclo unico first years.
Declare your IBAN if you do not already hold one, by the mandatory deadline of 31 December 2028.
Meet the merit requirement of art. 5.3 to receive the second instalment of the quota.
Keep enrolment and credits current, because the Agency verifies merit itself and can start a decadenza procedure with a 10-day rebuttal window.

research_notes.degree_level_confirmed:
Confirmed by direct quotation from the awarding body's own page, re-read in the finishing pass.
The DSU Toscana page states: "Al concorso possono partecipare gli studenti regolarmente iscritti per
il conseguimento del primo titolo di studio a corsi di laurea, laurea specialistica/magistrale,
dottorato di ricerca e scuole di specializzazione degli Atenei di Firenze, Pisa e Siena e degli altri
Istituti Superiori, Accademie di Belle Arti e Conservatori della Regione Toscana." The scuole di
specializzazione route is the single-cycle path into medicine and surgery, and the call names
laurea triennale, laurea magistrale and magistrale a ciclo unico separately, so the award funds a
bachelor's degree (laurea triennale) as well as higher levels. degree_levels is recorded as
"Bachelor's", with the higher levels recorded in programme_detail_official.degree_levels, as the
contract requires for an award covering both cycles.
